name: astromansion
description: Official JavaScript and TypeScript client for the AstroMansion astrology API.
author: Mustafa Yavuz Ak <founder@mustafayavuzak.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/generate/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests tools/generate/*.ts tools/generate/tsconfig.json examples package.json tsconfig.json tsup.config.ts eslint.config.js README.md EXAMPLES.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests tools/generate/*.ts tools/generate/tsconfig.json examples package.json tsconfig.json tsup.config.ts eslint.config.js README.md EXAMPLES.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run api-report:check
